m: 1. अनु-√ या to go towards or after, follow; to imitate, equal.
2. अनु-या mfn. following, VS. xv, 6.
a: अनुया — {c2c} P. 1 To follow, go after (fig. also); अनुयाहि साधुपदवीं Bh. 2. 77; अनुयास्यन्मुनितनयां Ś. 1. 29; त्वामनुयामि यद्यपि Ku. 4. 21. --2 To imitate, equal; न किलानुययुस्तस्य राजानो रक्षितुर्यशः R. 1. 27; 9. 6; अनुयातलीलः 16. 71; Śi. 12. 3 followed and imitated. --3 To attend, accompany; इयं मुसलमनुयाति कलेन हुंकृतेन Mu. 1. 4; अनुयातारुंधतीको वसिष्ठः U. 3. 48.

m: अनु-याग m. a subsequent or after sacrifice, Pāṇ. vii, 3, 62, Sch.
अनुयाजानुमन्त्रण n. reciting those formulas, KātyŚr.
अनुयाजार्थ mfn. belonging to or used at an Anuyāja, KātyŚr.

v: pu॰ anu + yaja--GaY yajYANgatvAt kutvABAvaH । darSapOrRamAsANgezu prayAjAdizu paYcasu yAgezu । “yajatizu ye yajAmahe nAnuyAjezu” iti SrutiH । “prayAjAnme anuyAjAMSca kevalAniti” f॰ 10, 51, 9, anuyAjAnumantraRam kA॰ 3, 5, 14 ।
m: अनु-याज m. a secondary or final sacrifice, RV. x, 51, 8 & 9 and 182, 2; ŚBr. &c.
a: अनुयाजः — [यज्-घञ्, कुत्वाभावः P. VII. 3. 62] A part of a sacrificial ceremony (यज्ञांगं); secondary or supplementary sacrificial rite; usually written अनूयाज q. v.

m: अनु-याज—प्रैष m. pl. the formulas belonging to the Anuyāja, KātyŚr.
अनु-याज—प्रसव m. permission to perform an Anuyāja, KātyŚr.
अनु-याज—वत् (अनुयाज-), mfn. having secondary sacrifices, MaitrS.; AitBr.
अनु-यान n. going after, following.

v: tri॰ anu yA--karttari ktaH । paScAdgantari, ruhagantari ca karmmaRi॰ ktayasya paScAdgamyate tAdfSe jane ।
m: अनु-यात mfn. following
followed
practised.
अनु-यातव्य mfn. to be followed.
अनु-यातृ m. a follower, companion.

v: avya॰ yAtrAyAM viBaktyarTe paScAdarTe vA avyayI॰ । yAtrAyAmityarTe, yAtrAyAH paScAdBAve ca । anugatA anurUpIkftA yAtrA yena prA॰ ba॰ । anuyAyivarge । “tyaktaBogasya me rAjan! vane vanyena jIvataH । kiM kAryya manuyAtreReti” rAmA॰ anugatA yAtrA prA॰ sa॰ । paScAdyAtrAyAM strI । tatprayojanamasyetyarTe Wak । AnuyAtrikaH anucare sevake tri॰ ।
m: अनु-यात्र f(आ)n. retinue, attendance
that which is required for a journey.
a: अनुयात्रं --त्रा — Retinue, train; attendance upon; following; त्यक्तभोगस्य मे राजन् वने वन्येन जीवतः . किं कार्यमनुयात्रेण Rām. --त्रं adv. In or after a procession.

v: tri॰ anuyAtrA paScAd yAtrA anugamanamastyasya Wan । paScAdgantari anucare “sarvvAnevAnuyAtrikavargAn tvayA saheti” Saku॰ ।
m: अनु-यात्रिक mfn. following, attendant, Śāk.
a: अनुयात्रिकः — [अनुयात्रा अनुगमनमस्त्यस्य ठन्] A follower, attendant; Ś. 1, 2.

s: [n] tri, (anuyAti paScAt gacCati, anu + yA + Rini .) sadfSaH । paScAdgAmI । yaTA । muKyAnuyAyini SiSAvityanubanDaSabdArTe amaraH ॥

v: tri॰ anuyAti paScAt gacCati anu + yA--Rini striyAM NIp । paScAdgantari, sevake, anucare “nyazeDi Sezo'pyanuyAyivargaH” iti raGuH sadfSe, muKyasyAnugantari SiSO ca ।
m: अनु-यायिन् mfn. going after
a follower, a dependant, attendant
following, consequent upon.
a: अनुयायिन् — a. [P. III. 2. 78] 1 Following; attending, consequent. --2 Like, similar. --3 Following a principal person as a teacher (मुख्यस्य अनुगंता शिशुः). --m. A follower (lit. & fig.); रामानुजानुयायिनः followers of the doctrines of R.; a dependent or attendant; न्यषेधि शेषोऽप्यनुयायिवर्गः R. 2. 4, 19.

m: अनुयायि-ता, f. or अनुयायि-त्व, n. succession.
अनु-यू mfn. (√ 2. यु), depending, dependent, ŚBr. xi.

v: avya॰ yUpe viBa॰ avyayI॰ । “yUpa ityarTe । tatra BavaH parimuKA॰ Yya । AnuyUpyaH yUpaBave tri॰ ।

m: अनु-यूपम् ind. along the Yūpa or sacrificial post, (g. परिमुखादि, q.v.)
अनु-यजुस् ind. according to the Yajus-formula, KātyŚr.
अनु-√ यम् (3. pl. -यच्छन्ति; Imper. -यच्छतु; p. fem. -यच्छमाना) to direct, guide, give a direction to, RV. i, 123, 13; iv, 57, 7 and vi, 75, 6; (perf. 3. pl. -येमुः Ā. 3. du. -येमाते) to follow, RV.
अनु-√ यम् to give over, Divyāv.
अनु-√ यत् Ā. -यतते, to strive to attain to or to reach, RV. ix, 92, 3.
अनु-यत mfn. followed (in hostile manner), RV. v, 41, 13.

v: avya॰ yave viBaktyarTe avyayI॰ । yave ityarTe । parimuKA॰ BavAdO Yya । Anuyavyam tatraBave padArTe tri॰ ।

m: अनु-यवम् ind. like barley, (g. परिमुखादि, q.v.)
अनु-यियासु mfn. wishing to follow, HPariś.

v: pu॰ anuyujyate kaTanAya niyujyate anu + yujaGaY । praSne । sati hi praSne, pfzwaH kaTanAya pravarttate । “nigfhyAnuyoge ceti” pA॰ । anupUrvvAt yujeH praSnArTakatA । tena “tvayA kiyadveti tamanvayuNkta” iti raGO praSnArTakatayA nirddeSaH ।
m: अनु-योग m. a question, examination
censure, reproof, Nyāyad.
religious meditation, spiritual union.
a: अनुयोगः — 1 A question, inquiry, examination; अनियंत्रणानुयोगस्तपस्विजनः Ś. 1; निगृह्यानुयोगे P. VIII. 2. 94; वार्ता˚मधुराक्षरया च वाचा R. 13. 71. --2 Censure, reproof. --3 Solicitation. --4 Exertion, effort; अनुयोगं विना तैलं तिलानां नोपजायते Pt. 2. 140. --5 Religious meditation; spiritual union. --6 Comment. --Comp. --कृत् {1} an interrogator. {2} a teacher, spiritual preceptor (अनुयोगं कृंतति प्रश्नविषयसंशयं छिनत्ति).

k.v: प्रश्नोऽनुयोगः पृच्छा च प्रतिवाक्योत्तरे समे। मिथ्याभियोगोऽभ्याख्यानमथ मिथ्याभिशंसनम्.।

m: अनुयोगद्वार N. of a sacred book, Jain.

s: puM, (anuyogaM praSnavizayasandehaM kfntati Cinatti, anuyoga + kft + kvip .) AcAryyaH । iti hemacandraH ॥
v: pu॰ anuyogaM praSnavizayasaMSayaM kfntati kfta Cedane kvip । AcAryye । kf--kvip । pfcCake tri॰ ।
m: अनु-योग—कृत् m. an Ācārya or spiritual teacher.
अनु-योगिन् mfn. ifc. combining, uniting
connected with
questioning.
a: अनुयोगिन् — a. 1 What combines or unites; connected with, situated in or on. --2 Examining, questioning.

s: klI, (anu + yuj + Ric + lyuw .) praSnaH । iti hemacandraH ॥
m: अनु-योजन n. question, questioning.

s: tri, (anuyujyate niyujyate, anu + yuj + SakyArTe Ryat .) nindArhaM । anupUrvvakanindArTayujaDAtoH karmmaRi yapratyayaH ॥ (prazwavyaH । jijYAsyaH । “mamedamiti yo brUyAt so'nuyojyo yaTAviDiH” iti manuH .)
v: tri॰ anuyujyate niyujyate “anu + yuja--SakyArTe AvaSyakArTe vA Ryat । praSnArhe avaSyaniyojye, tvayA kaTamitTaM kftamityAkzepeRa kftapraSne, AjYAkArake, dAsAdO ca “vAsavAnuyojyo duzmantaH praRamati” Saku॰ ।
m: अनु-योज्य mfn. to be examined or questioned, Mn.
to be enjoined or ordered
censurable
a servant, agent, delegate, Śāk.
a: अनुयोज्य — pot. p. Fit to be questioned, asked; asked with a reproof. --ज्यः A servant; obedient and humble servant; उभाभ्यामपि वासवानुयोज्यो दुष्यंतः प्रणमति Ś. 7; Ms. 8. 31.

s: [f] puM, (anu + yuj + tfc .) BftakADyApakaH । iti mahABArataM ॥ (praSnakarttA .)

m: अनु-योक्तव्य mfn. to be questioned, MBh.

v: tri॰ anu + yuja--tfc striyAM NIp । praSnakArake । BftakADyApake ca ।
m: अनु-योक्तृ m. an examiner, inquirer, teacher.
a: अनुयोक्तृ — m. An examiner, interrogator; inquirer; a teacher, especially hired or mercenary (भृतकाध्यापक).

v: avya॰ yuge viBa॰ avyayI॰ । yuga ityarTe । tatra BavaH parimuKA॰ Yya । AnuvugyaH anuyugaBave tri॰ ।

m: अनु-युगम् ind. according to the Yugas or four ages, Mn. i, 84.
अनु-√ युज् to join again, ŚBr.; AitBr.; to question, examine; to order; to enjoin: Caus. -योजयति, to place upon; to add, Kauś. : Desid. -युयुक्षति, to intend to question, MBh.
a: अनुयुज् — {c7c} A. 1 To ask, question; किं वस्तु विद्वन्गुरवे प्रदेयं त्वया कियद्वेति तमन्वयुंक्त R. 5. 18; अन्वयुंक्त गुरुमीश्वरः क्षितेः 11. 62; Śi. 13. 68. --2 To examine (as an accused), put on trial; Ms. 8. 79, 259. --3 To impart or give, as instruction. --4 To order, enjoin. --5 To select as husband.

s: puM, (anu + yuj + ktaH .) BftakADyetA । iti mahABArataM । (aBiyuktaH । ninditaH । jijYAsitapadArTaH । kftapraSnaH .)
v: tri॰ anu + yuja--kta । jijYAsite padArTe । kftapraSne, yaM prati kasyacit padArTasya jijYAsArTaM praSnaH kriyate tasmiMSca । “sa cAnuyukto vyAcazwAmiti KaRqanaKAdyam ।
m: अनु-युक्त mfn. ordered, enjoined
asked, inquired
examined, questioned
reprehended.
a: अनुयुक्त — p. p. 1 Asked, questioned, examined, ordered &c. --2 Censured, reproached.

m: अनु-युक्तिन् m. one who has enjoined, examined, (गणैष्टादि, q.v.)
a: अनुयुक्तिन् — a. [अस्त्यर्थे इनि] One who has ordered, examined; cf. गृहीतिन्, अधीतिन्.
